title: Leveraging the Potential of Prompt Engineering for Hate Speech Detection in Low-Resource Languages
reasoning: The paper benchmarks 'metaphor prompting' as a method to 'jailbreak' or bypass the built-in ethical safeguards and safety mechanisms of LLMs. It also explicitly evaluates the model's ability to detect hate speech using personas such as 'Religious Extremist' and categorizes hate speech based on identity factors including religion, ethnicity, and gender.
